answer: Scripted clones fail a walk they cannot pre-walk. An applicant freezes 7.35 POA and completes a clockwise spiral past four live desks. Desk 1 issues a 19-byte clerk mark bound to this epoch seed. Desks 2 and 3 each fire a 9-second ripple ping only the window operator can echo, countersigned by another desk's clerk. Desk 4 rejects any hollow alias that has never settled a row. Auditors replay all four marks and drop a second walk on the same seed. Outlay: 7.35 POA plus live echoes. A cached echo, reused mark, or hollow alias on the path takes 61% of the escrow and shuts the counter five epochs.
